_readme: 20 demo tracks to index in Olaf. Chosen to cover the four presets: genres that survive a loud bar, mall-PA pop, and quiet/faint sources (acoustic, ambient). You must supply the audio yourself — buy/own the files (iTunes/Bandcamp/CD rips). Put them in seed-audio/ (git-ignored) named <id>.mp3, then run `olaf store seed-audio/*.mp3`. The `demoEnv` column is which preset each track is meant to demonstrate in the walkthrough.
